description: Project IPAD, a database to catalogue the analysis of Fukushima Daiichi accident fragmental release material is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Peter Martin et al. The 2011 accident at Japan’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant released a considerable inventory of radioactive material into the local and global environments. Coverage: global (JP); published in 2020. Formats: Excel, Image, PDF. The data are held in Mendeley Data and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
